title: ADMU grad tops September 2026 psychologists computer-based licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Ateneo de Manila University achieved the highest score in the computer-based licensure examination for psychologists given earlier this month, the PRC said.

blocks.text: A graduate of Ateneo de Manila University achieved the highest score in the computer-based licensure examination for psychologists given earlier this month, the Professional Regulation Commission said.

According to the PRC, 490 test takers out of 560 passed the exam, given by the Board of Psychology at test centers in Metro Manila, Baguio, Butuan, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pampanga, Rosales, Tuguegarao and Puerto Princesa.

ADMU's Josemaria Ecequiel Naval Ledesma scored the top result of 91.70%, while the top performing schools with 30 or more examinees were ADMU and the University of Santo Tomas, with all of their test takers—37 and 35, respectively—passing.
